title: Water-Change and Maintenance Cadence
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reeftank:param event=maintenance
| stats latest(_time) as last_change by task tank
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_change)/86400,1), overdue=if(days_since>14,1,0)
| sort - days_since
description: Tracks when each tank last had a water change or filter clean so routine maintenance does not quietly slip.
value: Skipped water changes are the top cause of tank trouble; a cadence tracker keeps the boring-but-essential jobs on schedule.
implementation: Log maintenance events into `index=personal`; schedule weekly and flag overdue tasks per tank.
visualization: Table of maintenance tasks by days since last done.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when you last cleaned or changed the tank water, so the important routine jobs do not get forgotten.
